reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it promotes OneCoin packages, conditions an extra split on a time-limited upgrade, and directly urges members to upgrade. It also presents free packages tied to banking package codes, a €100 card fee upon approval, and a 25 EUR deduction for KYC document translation, although the available video evidence does not establish whether the services were delivered, accounts were charged, or anyone suffered a loss.

opening.argument: Judge, the speaker describes qualifications and limits rather than presenting every benefit as automatic. The card fee is deducted only “upon approval,” and members are told that coin transfers are limited to once a day, cannot be paired with a same-day exchange sale, and cannot cross lines. Those restrictions do not prove the service was sound, but they matter when assessing whether this is an unqualified promise of easy access to an asset.

citations.quote: The new card fee will be a hundred euro which will be deducted from your One Pay account upon approval.
You will be able to transfer coins once a day. Do note that you'll be unable to sell wantcoins on the exchange platform during the same day.
Additionally, bear in mind that no cross-line transactions are allowed, only upline or downline.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The upgrade invitation and deadline are promotional, but neither establishes that the extra split was guaranteed to yield money or that anyone received it. The accounting instruction describes how to claim a conditional package-code offer; it does not establish that codes were issued or redeemed. The document-upload passage concerns a stated KYC process, not evidence that credentials were misused.

citations.quote: If you upgrade to an Infinity package from either Tycoon, Premium or Festival by the 5th of June 2016, you will get one extra split on top of what the upgrade initially gives you.
Do note that in order to get the free package, or packages you need to be clear in your communication with the accounting department of the company.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Operational limits are not a warning about the risks of buying packages. The speaker explicitly urges members to upgrade for an extra split, and separately promotes free packages conditional on banking other package codes. Whether any benefit was delivered is unresolved, but the video itself solicits participation in those offers.

citations.quote: Visit your back end now and upgrade your package to take advantage of this astonishing offer!

opening.argument: Judge, much of this broadcast functions as a member operations update. It explains who can receive coin transfers, the daily transfer limit, the restriction on same-day exchange sales, and requirements for translated identity documents. It also directs members with questions to support. These details support reading the video as an explanation of account procedures, without treating the speaker's claims about those procedures as independently verified.

Each package comes with a set limit for transferrable coins daily.
you'll be unable to sell wantcoins on the exchange platform during the same day.
we'll kindly ask you to provide us with an officially translated copy of your KYC documents in English made by an authorized translator
have any questions regarding the new promotion, do not hesitate to contact our support team.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The opening identifies genuine sales language, but it omits the broadcast's operational explanations. The document request, for example, is accompanied by specific translation requirements. An instruction to report codes to accounting describes a process; those words alone do not establish what happened after a payment or whether the stated benefit was delivered.

citations.quote: the document should also be sealed and signed by a legal appropriate authority, for example a notary
Remember to explain which codes correspond in which payments when you send the Banquoix.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The operational material does not make the promotion incidental. The speaker tells viewers to upgrade immediately for an extra split and describes free packages earned by banking other package codes. Those are calls to participate in package offers, not merely demonstrations of existing account controls.

opening.argument: Judge, the concrete offers can be read as ordinary conditional promotions: buy ten event tickets in one category to receive one free, or bank specified package codes to receive a bonus code. The event tickets have stated prices, while the card and document-translation services have stated fees. None of that verifies the products or services, but a quoted price or bonus condition alone does not show a guaranteed financial return, a completed loss, or a failed redemption.

rebuttal.rebuttal: A time-limited upgrade and a free-code offer deserve scrutiny, but their conditions are stated rather than hidden in the cited passages. The prosecution also acknowledges that the video does not establish delivery, charges, or loss. The accounting and KYC instructions may be part of transactions; neither cited instruction, on its own, proves a fraudulent outcome.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The ticket discount does not explain away the package pitch. The speaker urges members to upgrade for an extra split, while the free package-code offer requires banking other codes and includes a payment-reporting step. Proof of an individual loss is absent, but the promotional mechanism is present in the video.
